paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in Philistia mite va delh ahong paikik in ngai in, "En-gedi gamdai ah David a-om," chih hilh in a-om hi.
heading: David In Saul Hinna Ahawi
english: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in Israel mi tengteng lak a telkhiak tuam mi sangthum api a, sathakte tenna suangpi lak lam ah David leh amite zong in ahohta uhi.
english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

paite: Lamkal ah belam huang kokhuk omna ava tung ua, khawl tawldam ding in Saul ava lut hi. Kokhuk sunggil lam ah David leh amite a-om uhi.
english: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

paite: David mite'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na kiang ah, ngai in, na khut ah na melma ka hon pe dia, atung ah hoih na saksak in na hih ding, achih ni ahita ve," achi uhi. Huchi in David athou a, simthamtak in Saul puan mong ava tan hi.
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, aden chiang in Saul puan mong ava tan in David lungsim asun mahmah hi.
english: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

paite: Huchi in amite kiang ah, "Amah TOUPA sathau nilh ahi, chih thei napi a, atung a khut zang a TOUPA sathau nilh ka toupa tung a hiai thil ka hih louh ding hi a," achi hi.
english: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”

paite: David in huai thu in amite akhamdai a, Saul sual dia akuan uh aphalta kei hi. Saul bel kokhuk a pan apawt a, apai nawnta hi.
english: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

paite: Anung zek in David leng athou a, kokhuk a pan apawt a, "Kumpipa, ka toupa," chi in Saul anungsap hi. Nunglam ah Saul ahong kihei a, David in amai a lei si in akunsuk hi.
english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Ngai in, David in na siatna azong, chi a mite'n na kiang a, agen uh bangziak a gingta na hia?
english: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

paite: Ngai in, tuni in TOUPA'N kokhuk ah ka khut ah nang ahon pia chih na mit mahmah in na mu hi. Mi khenkhatte'n nang that ding in ahon chi uh. Himahleh ka hon hawi hi. Ka toupa tung ah ka khut himhim ka kha kei ding, TOUPA sathau nilh ahi ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is Yahweh’s anointed.’

paite: Huai kia leng hilou in, pa, en in, na puan mong leng ka tawi hi. Na puan mong ka tan theih a, ka hon thahlouhna ah ka khut ah thil hoih lou leh tatlekna a-om kei, chih leh ka hinna lak tum in hon zongzong lechin leng, na tung ah ka khial kei chih thei in.
english: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

paite: TOUPA'N nang leh kei kikal ah vaihawm henla, TOUPA'N na tung ah ka phu hon laksak hen. Himahleh ke'n zaw na tung ah khut ka kha kei himhim ding.
english: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

paite: Nidanglai a paunak in, "Migilou a pan gitlouhna apawt zel," achi hi. "Himahleh ke'n bel na tung ah khut ka kha kei ding.
english: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

paite: Israel kumpipa kua zong in ahia ahong pawtkhiak? Kua ahia na delh? Ui sisa, uihik lel mo?
english: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA vaihawmpa hi henla, nang toh kei kikal ah vaihawm hen, hon mu in hon genpih henla, na khut a pan hon hunkhia hen," achi hi.
english: May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, David in Saul kiang a hiai thute agen khit in, Saul in, "Hiai ka tapa David aw hilou amaw?" achi hi. Huchi in aw suah in Saul akapta hi.
english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

paite: David kiang ah, "Kei sang in na diktatzaw, nang zaw ka tung ah thil hoih na hih a, ke'n bel thil hoih lou ka hih.
english: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

paite: Tuni in ka tung a thil hoih na hihdan na hihlang a, TOUPA'N na khut a kei ahon piak a leng na hon thahlouhna ah.
english: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.

paite: Mi'n amelma mu taleh bangmah lou in akhah mawk diam? Huaiziak in tuni a ka tung a na thilhih ah TOUPA'N thil hoih in nang họn thuk hen.
english: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

paite: Ngai in, kumpipa na hong hi ngei dia, Israel gam na khut ah hihkip in a-om ding chih ka theita hi.
english: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

paite: Huaiziak in ka nung a ka suan hong om dingte hihmang lou ding in TOUPA min in ka kiang ah kichiam inla, ka pa inkote a pan ka min thaimang ke'n," achi hi.
english: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

paite: Huchi in Saul kiang ah David akichiam hi. Huchi in inn ah Saul apai a, David leh amite leikohawm ah apaitou uhi.
english: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
